transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I've been struggling with really severe mood issues lately. For the last five months, I've been feeling deeply depressed, sad, and just completely empty inside. It's gotten to the point where I really need some help.

Have you ever had a period lasting several days or longer when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual? This would be different from your usual self, even if it didn’t feel like a problem at the time.

Yes, I actually experienced a period like that before this depression started. For about two months, I felt incredibly energetic, euphoric, and just full of vitality in a way that was completely different from my normal self. It felt like I had an endless amount of energy during that time.

Have you ever had hallucinations or strong beliefs that others said were not true during a time when you were not depressed or unusually energized? If so, did those symptoms last for at least two weeks on their own?

No, I've actually never had those experiences when my mood was normal or when I was depressed. Those strange beliefs and hallucinations only happened during that time when I was feeling extremely energized and active. They completely disappeared once that high-energy phase ended.
During that high-energy period, did you have hallucinations or very strong beliefs that others said were not true, such as hearing voices or feeling especially powerful or watched?

Yes, during that two-month high-energy period, I truly believed I was uniquely powerful and even thought I was being watched by others. I also heard voices that no one else could hear. These experiences only happened during that energized phase and completely stopped once it ended.
